
Pandoc example:
.
Here is a sidenote reference,[$1] and another.[$longnote]

[$1]: Here is the sidenote.

[$longnote]: Here's one with multiple blocks.

    Subsequent paragraphs are indented to show that they
belong to the previous sidenote.

        { some.code }

    The whole paragraph can be indented, or just the first
    line.  In this way, multi-paragraph sidenotes work like
    multi-paragraph list items.

This paragraph won't be part of the note, because it
isn't indented.
.
<style>
    .sidenote {
    float: right;
    clear: right;
    width: 25%;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #f9f9fb;
    border-left: 3px solid #c8c8d0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #333;
  }
</style><p>Here is a sidenote reference,<sup id="sidenote1">1</sup> and another.<sup id="sidenote2">2</sup></p>
<p>This paragraph won't be part of the note, because it
isn't indented.</p>
<!-- sidenote open -->
<span id="sidenote1" class="sidenote">
<p>Here is the sidenote.</p>
</span>
<span id="sidenote2" class="sidenote">
<p>Here's one with multiple blocks.</p>
<p>Subsequent paragraphs are indented to show that they
belong to the previous sidenote.</p>
<pre><code>{ some.code }
</code></pre>
<p>The whole paragraph can be indented, or just the first
line.  In this way, multi-paragraph sidenotes work like
multi-paragraph list items.</p>
</span>
<!-- sidenote close -->
.



They could terminate each other:

.
[$1][$2][$3]

[$1]: foo
[$2]: bar
[$3]: baz
.
<style>
    .sidenote {
    float: right;
    clear: right;
    width: 25%;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #f9f9fb;
    border-left: 3px solid #c8c8d0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #333;
  }
</style><p><sup id="sidenote1">1</sup><sup id="sidenote2">2</sup><sup id="sidenote3">3</sup></p>
<!-- sidenote open -->
<span id="sidenote1" class="sidenote">
<p>foo</p>
</span>
<span id="sidenote2" class="sidenote">
<p>bar</p>
</span>
<span id="sidenote3" class="sidenote">
<p>baz</p>
</span>
<!-- sidenote close -->
.


They could be inside blockquotes, and are lazy:
.
[$foo]

> [$foo]: bar
baz
.
<style>
    .sidenote {
    float: right;
    clear: right;
    width: 25%;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #f9f9fb;
    border-left: 3px solid #c8c8d0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #333;
  }
</style><p><sup id="sidenote1">1</sup></p>
<blockquote></blockquote>
<!-- sidenote open -->
<span id="sidenote1" class="sidenote">
<p>bar
baz</p>
</span>
<!-- sidenote close -->
.


Their labels could not contain spaces or newlines:

.
[$ foo]: bar baz

[$foo
]: bar baz
.
<p>[$ foo]: bar baz</p>
<p>[$foo
]: bar baz</p>
.


We support inline notes too (pandoc example):

.
Here is an inline note.$[Inlines notes are easier to write, since
you don't have to pick an identifier and move down to type the
note.]
.
<style>
    .sidenote {
    float: right;
    clear: right;
    width: 25%;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #f9f9fb;
    border-left: 3px solid #c8c8d0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #333;
  }
</style><p>Here is an inline note.<sup id="sidenote1">1</sup></p>
<!-- sidenote open -->
<span id="sidenote1" class="sidenote">
Inlines notes are easier to write, since
you don't have to pick an identifier and move down to type the
note.</span>
<!-- sidenote close -->
.


They could have arbitrary markup:

.
foo$[ *bar* ]
.
<style>
    .sidenote {
    float: right;
    clear: right;
    width: 25%;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #f9f9fb;
    border-left: 3px solid #c8c8d0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #333;
  }
</style><p>foo<sup id="sidenote1">1</sup></p>
<!-- sidenote open -->
<span id="sidenote1" class="sidenote">
 <em>bar</em> </span>
<!-- sidenote close -->
.


Duplicate sidenotes:
.
[$xxxxx] [$xxxxx]

[$xxxxx]: foo
.
<style>
    .sidenote {
    float: right;
    clear: right;
    width: 25%;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #f9f9fb;
    border-left: 3px solid #c8c8d0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #333;
  }
</style><p><sup id="sidenote1">1</sup> <sup id="sidenote1">1</sup></p>
<!-- sidenote open -->
<span id="sidenote1" class="sidenote">
<p>foo</p>
</span>
<!-- sidenote close -->
.


Indents:

.
[$xxxxx] [$yyyyy]

[$xxxxx]: foo
    ---

[$yyyyy]: foo
   ---
.
<style>
    .sidenote {
    float: right;
    clear: right;
    width: 25%;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #f9f9fb;
    border-left: 3px solid #c8c8d0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #333;
  }
</style><p><sup id="sidenote1">1</sup> <sup id="sidenote2">2</sup></p>
<hr>
<!-- sidenote open -->
<span id="sidenote1" class="sidenote">
<h2>foo</h2>
</span>
<span id="sidenote2" class="sidenote">
<p>foo</p>
</span>
<!-- sidenote close -->
.


Indents for the first line:

.
[$xxxxx] [$yyyyy]

[$xxxxx]:       foo

[$yyyyy]:        foo
.
<style>
    .sidenote {
    float: right;
    clear: right;
    width: 25%;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;

    border-left: 3px solid #c8c8d0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #333;
  }

<!-- sidenote open -->
<span id="sidenote1" class="sidenote">
<p>foo</p>
</span>
<span id="sidenote2" class="sidenote">
<pre><code>foo
</code></pre>
</span>
<!-- sidenote close -->
.

.
[$__proto__]

[$__proto__]: blah
.

</span>

.

.

Regression test for #42
.
foo[$1] bar[$2].

[$1]:[$2]: baz
.
<style>
    .sidenote {
    float: right;
    clear: right;
    width: 25%;
    margin: 0 0 0.5rem 1rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background: #f9f9fb;
    border-left: 3px solid #c8c8d0;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
    font-size: 0.9em;
    color: #333;
  }
</style><p>foo<sup id="sidenote1">1</sup> bar<sup id="sidenote2">2</sup>.</p>
<!-- sidenote open -->
<span id="sidenote1" class="sidenote">
</span>
<span id="sidenote2" class="sidenote">
<p>baz</p>
</span>
<!-- sidenote close -->
.



False identifiers
.
[^this is a false block]

[$]:

This is a 1 false $[note

[$]: false note 2

[$ 3]: false note 3

[$
]: false note 4

[$5]

[$6]:

[$7]:\t\tfoo
.
<p>[^this is a false block]</p>
<p>[$]:</p>
<p>This is a 1 false $[note</p>
<p>[$]: false note 2</p>
<p>[$ 3]: false note 3</p>
<p>[$
]: false note 4</p>
<p>[$5]</p>
.
